system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: I want to perform the following action: Perform these two different actions simultaneously: deds_track_loan_status and deds_schedule_inspection.. my application_id is DEDS-APP-20000003, my preferred_date is dummy_preferred_date_4085, my loan_id is dummy_loan_id_3901.

function.name: deds_schedule_inspection
function.description: Schedules a physical inspection of the implemented project. Project must be in 'completed' status. Transitions inspection_status to 'scheduled'. Requires session_token. Does NOT perform inspection. Fails if project not completed or scheduling conflict.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

function.name: deds_track_loan_status
function.description: Tracks loan_status ('not_applied', 'applied', 'sanctioned', 'rejected', 'disbursed'). Requires session_token. Does NOT modify loan. Fails if loan_id is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

loan_id.description: Unique identifier of the loan application.
